title: heavytails: Pure-Python heavy-tailed probability distributions
description: heavytails is a pure-Python library implementing heavy-tailed probability distributions from first principles, without third-party runtime dependencies. It provides continuous and discrete heavy-tailed families, tail index estimators, and diagnostic utilities for extreme value analysis, risk management, and financial modelling.
